'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Michael Pistone DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Michael Pistone]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''STRINGER BELL'''. Username '''PISTONE 24'''. Handwritten. DARK checked. Event date 8/13/11, Worlds Day 2. Starting objective is line 59 Ralltiir Operations (sheet writes / Flip Side; the flip is the back, not a second card). Lines 15, 29, 47, and 54 have a written <V> and an empty checkbox, entered as (V). No Light Side sheet (page 97 is blank).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Ralltiir Operations]]
* '''Username:''' PISTONE 24
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
